title: Early Kuba Medallion rug, Khanate Period
notes: Early Kuba Medallion rug, Khanate Period. Azerbaijan. I believe this rug is from the late 17th or early 18th century. Turk ve Islam Eserleri Museum, Istanbul Acquired 13 May 1916. Inv. no. 99 (1904) from the Mosque of Korkmazoglu at Sivas, Yetkin, Serare, Early Caucasian Carpets in Turkey, Vol. I, London, 1978, pl. 99.
